descent_rate.algorithm: single-site descent from each seeded random start, to a local minimum, averaged over restarts and over seeds

descent_rate_half_width.algorithm: half the 95% normal interval of the per-seed rates

enumerated_ground_energy.algorithm: exhaustive enumeration of all 2**18 configurations at zero field

planted_energy.algorithm: the energy of the state the couplings were built around, an upper bound on the ground state and not the ground state here

restart_success.algorithm: the fraction of seeds where at least one of the restarts reached the ground state --- random-restart descent, which is the baseline a policy has actually to beat
